name: Certified Cognitive Continuity Fabric
core_rule: continuity != truth != selection != projection != authority; semantic unity does not erase causal, collection, epoch, process, storage or authority boundaries
pipeline: typed semantic identity + valid/transaction time + provenance
UnifiedDB typed query IR with explicit SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED/PRIORITY algebra
sparse epoch-bound latent activation update with inhibition/decay/budget
bounded Assembly compile with exact anchors and selection receipt
MRSC reader rail and exact projected-view receipt
outcome/re-entry receipt becomes canonical event before persistent derived-memory mutation
background derivation/activation continues between model invocations

cannot_by_itself_validate: whether an authentic association is cognitively relevant/correct for the current task

physical_policy: same Clay semantics and receipts across replaceable placements; same-process zero-copy only where ABI/lifetime evidence supports it; cross-process transport gets its own shared-memory/IPC contract; secrets/effect authority and untrusted execution remain isolated by default
memory_policy: dual path: low-cost background associative availability plus explicit exact/graph/vector/FTS fallback and validation
research_boundary: C3F is a synthesis architecture, not an independently validated generation. No branch convergence counts as replication when ancestry overlaps.
